title: Missing #[non_exhaustive] on InlineUUBlock and InlineYEncBlock in mime-tree
description: InlineUUBlock (mime-tree/src/uuencode.rs) and InlineYEncBlock (mime-tree/src/yenc.rs) are all-pub-field structs with no #[non_exhaustive] attribute. Both are scan output types returned by scan_inline_uuencode() and scan_inline_yencode(). Callers can construct them with struct literals. What goes wrong: adding a field to either struct (e.g. to surface new metadata from the inline scan) is a breaking change without #[non_exhaustive]. Also, PartEntry in uuencoding-multi/src/collection.rs has the same issue — it is a public all-pub-field struct with no #[non_exhaustive]. All three need the attribute.
